title: 第17章 寿命＋7第18章 魔将出击
content_zh:
只有学习了锻造术或者一阶的炼器术，才能熔炼矿石和硬化骨这些材料，用来打造成更高品质的装备。
一般直接用原材料经过简单加工而得到的装备，都是一星，加成极低，完全无法发挥出材料本身的特质，方南山拥有特殊天赋，也只能赋予产品一部分额外属性。
但他的手艺水平不高，能激活的属性也就比较平常，随着他的手艺提升，以后同样的材料，会制作出更加高属性的产品。
现实里也一样，他泡茶技术提升之后，变异出极品好茶的概率也将大大提升。
基础工具制作的下一层进阶，是锻造术，裁缝术，雕刻术，木匠，瓦匠等等，甚至是炼器术也要以此为基础条件。
五级骷髅枪兵掉落的骨枪和骨盾，都是可以进行再加工的装备。
【骨质疏松的长枪（0阶一星）】
攻击力6+1
【骨质疏松的圆盾（0阶一星）】
防御力3
这是一个还不到一尺直径的小小圆盾，好像跟骷髅兵的左手连成一体的，它们的姿势就是左手盾挡在前，右手长枪贴着盾对着前面，时刻戒备的样子。
击杀五级骷髅兵需要五箭，多少还是有点影响清怪速度的，方南山后面这一个多小时，也没能突破一千的杀敌大关，今天是无法获取千魔斩的称号了。
距离已经不远了，只差六十个。
经验值又早早溢出了，升到五级只需要一千的经验，也就是五级的骷髅兵只需要斩杀四十个。
他压了一下等级，没有到五，倒是把新学习的五种基础功法给升级了，分别是猛虎式，灵猴式，飞燕式，阴蛇式和大鹏式，这些功法学习和提升也没有增加属性，但是如果全部提升到大师级，以后晋升一阶之后，有机会领悟它们的形态技以及终极体式。
当然他主要还是为了方便在现实里修炼，在这里灌输的知识，现实也可以用，但这些知识属于原本，需要经过解读理解，才能在现实世界里准确的修练。
不像在这里，直接灌入经验值，就提升熟练度了。
现实里也有各种基础功法的解析版本，国内和国外还有不同的理解，修炼上可能也会有差异。
各个流派都宣称自己的解读才是正统的，比较着名的武道修练馆，便都有自己的独特理解，有的专注于某一种的功法，深入解析，利用科学的方法来逐一分析，还挺有效率的。
华国的教科书里，也收录了几种体式，都是国际上比较公认的，最科学最合理，效率最好的解析。

方南山当然也希望可以从功法的原本中，解读出新的东西，现实里原有的解读，也会作为一种借鉴。
所以在这里他不惜多花费金钱和经验值，也学习并提升这些几乎对实力没什么帮助的功法。
“今天的杀戮，就到此为止吧！”
回到据点中，他清理背包空间的材料，第二波的战斗，他斩杀了四级五级的骷髅怪约一百五十个，“魔晶*745，硬化骨*745，骨盾*5，骨枪*7……”
还有杀了五六个小队长级别的精英，勋章也得到好几个，骨质指环和项链各有四个，还有一个骨质头盔，样子太丑了，全部卖掉。
这一波就有一万六千元，加上之前也有一万多，这一天的收益就高达三万，加上昨天还有些剩钱，制作弓箭花费了五千多，还有箭矢的消耗几百元。
他现在的财富已经达到：元，贡献值：158，功勋值:3063，名望值：10
content_en:
Only by learning the blacksmithing technique or the first-level weapon refining technique can materials such as ore and hardened bone be smelted to create higher quality equipment.
Generally, equipment obtained directly from raw materials through simple processing is one-star, with extremely low bonuses, and cannot bring out the characteristics of the material itself at all. Fang Nanshan has a special talent, which can only give the product some additional attributes.
However, his skill level is not high, and the attributes that can be activated are relatively ordinary. As his skills improve, the same materials will be used to produce products with higher attributes in the future.
The same is true in reality. After his tea-making skills improve, the probability of mutating the best tea will also greatly increase.
The next level of advancement in basic tool making is blacksmithing, tailoring, carving, carpentry, bricklaying, etc. Even the weapon refining technique requires this as the basic condition.
The bone guns and bone shields dropped by level five skeleton spearmen are equipment that can be reprocessed.
[Osteoporosis Spear (Level 0, One Star)]
Attack power 6+1
[Osteoporosis Buckler (Level 0, One Star)]
Defense 3
This is a small round shield less than a foot in diameter, which seems to be integrated with the left hand of the skeleton soldier. Their posture is that the shield in their left hand is blocking the front, and the spear in their right hand is facing the front against the shield, always on guard.
It takes five arrows to kill a level five skeleton soldier, which somewhat affects the speed of clearing monsters. Fang Nanshan has not been able to break through the kill mark of one thousand enemies for more than an hour. Today, he will not be able to obtain the title of Thousand Demon Killer.
The distance is not far, only sixty left.
The experience value has overflowed early again. It only takes one thousand experience to upgrade to level five, which means that level five skeleton soldiers only need to kill forty.
He lowered the level and found that it was not up to five, but he had upgraded the five newly learned basic skills, namely the Tiger Style, the Spiritual Monkey Style, the Flying Swallow Style, the Yin Snake Style, and the Dapeng Style. Learning and upgrading these skills did not increase the attributes, but if they were all upgraded to the master level, after being promoted to the first level in the future, they would have the opportunity to understand their form skills and ultimate postures.
Of course, it is mainly for the convenience of practicing in reality. The knowledge instilled here can also be used in reality, but this knowledge belongs to the original and needs to be interpreted and understood before it can be accurately practiced in the real world.
Unlike here, where experience points are directly poured in to increase proficiency.
In reality, there are also analytical versions of various basic exercises. There are different understandings at home and abroad, and there may be differences in practice.
Each school claims that its interpretation is orthodox. The more famous martial arts training halls all have their own unique understandings. Some focus on a certain kind of exercise, analyze it in depth, and use scientific methods to analyze each one, which is quite efficient.
Several postures are also included in Chinese textbooks, which are internationally recognized as the most scientific, reasonable and efficient analysis.
Of course, Fang Nanshan also hopes to interpret new things from the original practice, and the original interpretation in reality will also serve as a reference.
So here he did not hesitate to spend more money and experience points to learn and improve these techniques that had little help to his strength.
"Let's stop today's killing!"
Returning to the stronghold, he cleaned up the materials in the backpack space. In the second wave of battle, he killed about 150 level 4 and 5 skeleton monsters. "Magic crystal*745, hardened bone*745, bone shield*5, bone gun*7..."
He also killed five or six squad leader-level elites and received several medals, four bone rings and necklaces each, and a bone helmet. It looked so ugly that he sold them all.
This wave has 16,000 yuan, plus more than 10,000 yuan before, this day's income is as high as 30,000 yuan, plus there is some leftover money from yesterday, it cost more than 5,000 yuan to make the bow and arrows, and several hundred yuan for the arrows.
